mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_failure_diagnoses (id, task_id, execution_id, category, confidence, failed_step, element_key, signature, suggested_locator_type, suggested_locator_value, reason, suggestion, source, model, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{executionId}, #{category}, #{confidence}, #{failedStep}, #{elementKey}, #{signature}, #{suggestedLocatorType}, #{suggestedLocatorValue}, #{reason}, #{suggestion}, #{source}, #{model}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_failure_diagnoses WHERE signature = #{signature}
mapper.update: UPDATE task_failure_diagnoses SET applied_at = #{appliedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
